annotations.title: Check a New York taxi or ride-app driver's licence

description: Check a New York taxi or ride-app driver's licence. Whether a TLC licence number is active on New York City's daily open data for for-hire (Uber, Lyft, car service) and taxi drivers, its expiry date, and, if a name is given, whether it matches (the name on the licence is never returned). Other cities get the official way to check.

city.description: City: nyc (live check) or another city id for guidance. Defaults to nyc.

name.description: Optional name the driver gave, to check it matches.

number.description: The TLC licence number shown in the app or on the partition card.
